text:
lina_cs: Hey all — kicking off Willow onboarding. Quick context: Willow is a two-sided marketplace, initial pilot scope is 10k queries/month, goal is to validate latency+cost for a PLG funnel. Proposed kickoff: Wed May 14 10:30am PT. Agenda: 1) success criteria 2) owners 3) infra/access 4) timeline 5) biggest risks. Internal doc: https://redwood.internal/onboard/willow (please use company VPN).

ben_pm: Thanks Lina. Product priorities — p95 latency <150ms, cost target <$0.001/token avg, pilot ready in ~30 days. I'll own stakeholder comms and prioritization.

ajay_se: I'll own model integration + prompt suite. Need API keys + sample dataset by Mon May 6. @lina_cs can you request access? I'll prepare regression tests.

maria_eng: I'll spin up a dedicated staging cluster and dashboards. ETA ~2 weeks if we get keys and sample traffic patterns. Need expected QPS and token lengths.

tess_ops: Quick ops note — billing contact + contract effective date? Also, do they require EU data residency? Need to know for VPC/KMS config.

lina_cs: Contract was signed yesterday; they require EU region for production. @tess_ops can you start the VPC/KMS checklist and compliance intake? I'll add the requirements to the playbook.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Willow Onboarding Kickoff" — Wed May 14 10:30am PT — Attendees: lina_cs, ben_pm, ajay_se, maria_eng, tess_ops. Link: https://calendar.internal/event/abc123

ben_pm: Quick success-criteria draft (for kickoff review):
- Pilot accepts 1k+ queries/day on staging
- p95 latency <150ms under pilot load
- Functional regression <1% vs baseline for top 50 prompts
- Dashboard + alerting live
- Support runbook + escalation path documented

ajay_se: For regression I need baseline prompt set + expected outputs. I'll put a folder under the shared drive: /onboard/willow/prompts and request dataset there.

lina_cs: I'll run an enablement session for CS the week of May 20 and set cadence: weekly 30m eng sync + biweekly stakeholder review.

maria_eng: Note — staging GPU pool is available but recommend quantized model for the pilot to meet cost targets. Suggest q4_8 profile as a start.

tess_ops: EU KMS required — opening ticket with security: SEC-9345. Also starting the VPC request (VPC-712). Will follow up with network/IP ranges.

ben_pm: Risk: potential query spikes from marketplace events. Proposed mitigation: autoscale policy + fallback routing to cheaper model variant. @maria_eng can you confirm autoscale thresholds?

maria_eng: Yes — can set autoscale at 2x baseline traffic and fallback route to `redwood-small` with graceful degradation and a visible metric on the dashboard.

lina_cs: Next steps capture (action owners):
- ajay_se: upload sample prompts + dataset by Mon May 6
- maria_eng: staging infra + dashboards by Tue May 20
- tess_ops: KMS ticket + VPC request by Fri May 10
- ben_pm: finalize success-criteria doc by May 8
I'll run the kickoff on May 14 and share meeting notes + action items. :rocket: Any objections or missing stakeholders to add?

ben_pm: No objections. Please add finance billing contact `sophie_fin` to the invite.

lina_cs: Added sophie_fin. I'll update the calendar and playbook. Thanks everyone :) :thumbsup:
